notesI18n.zh:
· 修复：设置 → AI 引擎里改了服务商或模型后，点整个弹窗底部的「保存」却没生效（那个按钮只存了默认引擎）
· 整个板块现在只有一个保存按钮，保存结果与「有未保存的改动」都显示在按钮旁边，不用再进折叠块里找
· 服务商/模型保存失败时不再静默丢弃改动：会说明是哪一块、为什么，并展开那一块
notesI18n.en:
· Fix: after changing the provider or model under Settings → AI engine, clicking the dialog's bottom Save did nothing — that button only wrote the default engine
· The pane now has a single Save button, and both the result and an “unsaved changes” hint appear right next to it, so there is no inner button to hunt for
· A failed provider/model save is no longer silent: it names the block that failed and why, and expands it
